ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated at the distal tips and as scattered small-diameter circular points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch with internal black mottling on the far-left distal tip; smaller, fragmented white patch on the far-right distal tip; numerous small circular high-contrast white spots (rosettes) distributed across the central and upper regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the center, approximately 40 degrees, with significant vertical penetration into the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge; the left lobe shows frequent low-amplitude serrations, while the right lobe shows larger, irregular notches and high-amplitude jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a smooth upward curve, terminating in pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacle attachment scars) concentrated in the medial zones and central areas of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear white pixel streaks are detectable on the mid-left lobe surface, consistent with rake mark morphology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness and tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe; visible cluster of live barnacles on the upper-left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Combination of high-density circular scarring across the central black pigmentation and significantly asymmetric trailing edge erosion.
